title: Anthropic Startup Program: 1 Year Free Claude Team + $1,000 API Credits

beats.text: Why is Anthropic Startup Program a major breakthrough? Because 1 Free Year of Claude Team Plan (for up to 5 seats, ~$1,800/yr value) plus $1,000 in direct Claude API credits (scaleable to $100,000+ for VC-backed startups) Eligibility: Bootstrapped, pre-seed, seed, or funded startups founded within the last 5 years; Active working prototype or live product demonstrating a genuine Claude use case; Company-domain email address required (no personal Gmail, Outlook, or Yahoo addresses).
